consequence.statement: RBAC and CRD manifests must be updated to authorize and define TCPServersTransport resources when using the KubernetesCRD provider.

original.statement: Traefik v3.0.0 introduces TCPServersTransport support; when using the KubernetesCRD provider, RBAC and CRD manifests must be updated to recognize this new resource type.

decision.reason: [ev-c160fecc6f71] is the v2-to-v3 migration guide. It says that because TCPServersTransport support was added, "it is therefore necessary to update RBAC and CRD manifests" when using the KubernetesCRD provider. A step the guide calls necessary is a mandatory operator step, so migration-required (action) is the right kind rather than behavior-change. The proposed statement matches the evidence: when the KubernetesCRD provider is used, the RBAC and CRD manifests must be updated for TCPServersTransport.
